title: Release and shorten a clamped cargo load bar
instruction: Remove the clamping load and shorten the cargo bar until both feet clear the walls. Leave it unloaded on both cradles with both grippers clear.
context: Heavy and tractor-trailer truck drivers secure cargo as a core duty; BLS reports about2.2million workers in2025. This full-scale cargo-bar fixture isolates safe removal and shortening of an installed compression restraint. It represents a documented commercial load-bar procedure, without a vehicle load-rating claim.
setup: Standard YAM station; table z0.7475m. Original wall frame at(0.24,0,0.7475)m, with opposing inner faces y=±0.600m, wall height140mm and two diameter-matched cradles. The full-scale bar starts clamped between them: outer-tube origin(0.24,-0.011667,0.7975)m, rotated-90deg aboutY so its handle sweeps horizontally. Hollow outer/inner tubes are740/600mm long,36/25mm outside diameter; rack travel0–50mm. The bar has actual convex rack/pinion teeth, a coaxial24-tooth ratchet, two independent passive pawls, physical release cams and a trigger/keeper latch. Pinion pitch radius12.7324mm. Two63.5×101.6×12mm compliant foot surrogates start1.667mm compressed, on12kN/m passive springs. Initial rack23.333mm, pinion-1.83260rad; handle and trigger closed. Gear/cam dimensions, mass/COM/inertia, compliance and friction are authored. Full primitive tables, joint frames and reset values are in scene.json and PARAMETERS.md. No vehicle, cargo or operating load rating is implied. The free bar is1.908kg; all body masses and density-derived COM/principal tensors are specified in PARAMETERS.md. The original PC guard has circular ports; actual rack guides, pad rods/bushes and a slotted trigger retain contact. All8 joint pairs collide. The aluminium frame is11kg and anchored.
scoring: 0.25 when both pad springs are unloaded within0.5mm and the rack has retracted at least2mm;0.5 when rack extension≤6mm and both foot-to-wall gaps≥4.5mm;0.75 when the bar rests within2mm of its cradle target, with trigger≤1mm. Full score requires2s below8mm/s and0.15rad/s with robot clearance≥20mm. Credit is current-state. Joint/body inconsistency, rack/pinion skip over0.5mm, penetration>0.35mm, fixture movement, invalid state or loss latch zero. No handle-stroke counter or expert path is required.
reset_notes: Seed0, no jitter. Restore every root and joint from scene.json initial values, zero velocities, and independently restore passive drive rest targets to zero. Initial pad compression is not the spring equilibrium. Clear controller/scorer/trace-reader state; repeat native cases after independent resets.
fidelity: Original full-scale fixture follows the documented HF96811 latch/full-forward release and two-pawl telescoping-bar function. Hidden geometry, guard, springs, contacts and mass properties are authored; the separate USCC pad envelope is not HF geometry. Both arms support the bar until cradle placement. CPU diagnostics and ideal tracking do not establish native Isaac/YAM grasp, hardware or Dream success.
scores: Native robot expert: not run; Dream-1: not run. Supplemental MuJoCo mechanism probes are not Isaac or robot demonstrations.
